messages.content: 如果我從紐約出發，前往洛杉磯，然後從洛杉磯前往邁阿密，最後從邁阿密返回紐約，總共的距離是多少公里？

function.name: geo_distance_calculate
function.description: Calculate the geographic distance between two given locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting location for the distance calculation.

end_location.description: The destination location for the distance calculation.

units.description: Optional. The desired units for the resulting distance ('miles' or 'kilometers'). Defaults to 'miles'.

The user asks: "If I start from New York, go to Los Angeles, then from LA to Miami, and finally from Miami back to New York, what is the total distance in kilometers?" We need to calculate distances between NYC to LA, LA to Miami, Miami to NYC. Use the geo_distance_calculate function. Provide arguments: start_location, end_location, units='kilometers'.

We should call the function three times? Or we can combine into one? The function calculates distance between two points; we need to sum them.

But we cannot do arithmetic inside the function call; we need to get results first. So we might need to call the function multiple times. However, the instructions say we can only output JSON objects when calling the function. But we can also produce normal text after receiving responses. So we can call the function once per pair. We'll do:

First call: start_location="New York", end_location="Los Angeles", units="kilometers". Then second: start_location="Los Angeles", end_location="Miami", units="kilometers". Third: start_location="Miami", end_location="New York", units="kilometers".

But maybe we can pass all pairs at once? The function signature expects single start_location and end_location. So we need separate calls.

Thus we will produce three function calls sequentially. After each call, we will receive response. Then we compute sum. Then respond with total distance.

We need to ensure we follow the format: JSON object with name and arguments. For each call, we produce a JSON object. Then we wait for response. Then we produce next call. After third, we compute sum.
